scope: The historical kiln-core revision that the imported cairn-core declares as its exact Git dependency. It is consumed only as cairn-core's transitive producer dependency; Kiln's own onix-kiln-core remains the canonical core, and no Kiln crate imports this copy.
nonclaims: This local immutable import is not remote publication, source authority, source trust, or release eligibility. A source checkout is needed only to reproduce the import, never to build Kiln.
manifest_normalization: Absent workspace members are pruned from the retained root manifest so Cargo can read the partial import without resolving unselected upstream packages.
formatter_scope: Tree-local rustfmt configuration sets disable_all_formatting so the host workspace formatter covers Kiln-owned sources without rewriting pinned upstream bytes.
